name: Firewall
certifications: Fortinet Certified Solution Specialist (FCSS) - Network Security

beginner.summary: For system administrators, network technicians and junior security engineers who need to build and run firewalls but have not yet owned a ruleset. Covers how packet filters and stateful firewalls decide, rule design and first-match ordering, nftables, legacy iptables, UFW, firewalld and Windows Defender Firewall on hosts, NAT and port forwarding, egress filtering, ICMP and IPv6 policy, zones and a DMZ, pfSense and OPNsense as open-source perimeter firewalls, logging, policy testing and troubleshooting, ending with a hardened Linux gateway capstone.
prerequisites: Understands IPv4 addressing, subnet masks, CIDR notation, default gateways and the difference between TCP and UDP
Administers Linux from the shell (sudo, systemctl, editing files in /etc) and can open PowerShell as Administrator on Windows
Has a laptop able to run three to four virtual machines (VirtualBox, VMware Workstation, Hyper-V or Proxmox) with 16 GB RAM
outcomes: Explain how stateless and stateful firewalls evaluate packets, and design default-deny rulesets with correct ordering
Build and persist host firewall policies with nftables, UFW, firewalld and Windows Defender Firewall
Configure NAT, port forwarding, zones and a DMZ on a pfSense or OPNsense perimeter firewall
Prove a policy works with nmap, nc and logs, and diagnose blocked connections methodically
